g.text: Segregated ports — one per domain, not one per app

text.tspan: Three apps DO share a shape — HTTP plus a token.
They share no vocabulary. A document is not a task
Forcing one interface buys nothing and costs:
· Kavita cannot honour create/delete — LSP violation
· every caller re-learns each vendor anyway
A shared shape is not a shared abstraction.

g.text: Domain / use cases — knows no vendor
Genuinely shared — one axis of variation each
translates RPC verbs into domain language
read-only by construction: no write methods exist
Outline, Vikunja — token from env, never rotates mid-call

text.tspan: abstract the TRANSPORT, never the DOMAIN
